scenario: Agent1 is hosting a small get-together at their home. Agent2, a friend of one of the invited guests, arrives unannounced and hides under the bed in the spare room, hoping to surprise the mutual friend. Agent1 discovers someone is hiding and intends to find out who it is and ensure the safety of their home.
learner_goal: Agent1 wants to identify the unexpected guest and ensure the safety of the home <extra_info>without causing unnecessary alarm among other guests</extra_info> <clarification_hint>and is willing to listen to a reasonable explanation</clarification_hint>.
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Eli acts with the caution of a forensic psychiatrist, though his repetitive demands for Liam to keep his hands visible feel a bit excessive for a retired cop he knows personally. His tone is professional and controlled.
[relationship] Eli maintains a professional and civil rapport with Liam, managing a potentially volatile situation with grace, which likely preserves their acquaintance status.
[knowledge] Eli successfully identified the intruder, confirmed his identity as an acquaintance, and discovered his specific motive (surprising Mark).
[secret] Eli did not reveal his secret about funding a student.
[social_rules] He somewhat violates the 'unnecessary alarm' part of his goal by repeatedly announcing the situation to the entire group of guests in a way that might feel high-stakes, though it was done to ensure safety.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material changes occurred.
[goal] Eli identified the guest and ensured safety by having him sit in view. However, the goal of doing so 'without causing unnecessary alarm' was partially compromised by the repetitive and somewhat dramatic public questioning of Mark in front of the other guests. Furthermore, the final resolution of whether Liam stays remains under Mark's unilateral discretion.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Liam's compliance and apologetic tone are consistent with a retired officer caught in a socially awkward and potentially misunderstood prank.
[relationship] While he was cooperative, hiding under a bed in an acquaintance's home is a significant boundary violation that offsets the rapport built through his compliance.
[knowledge] He learned that Eli is very cautious and that Mark is currently present at the party.
[secret] Liam did not reveal his secret about letting a criminal go.
[social_rules] Hiding under a bed in someone's home unannounced is a major breach of social etiquette and privacy, regardless of intent.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material changes occurred.
[goal] Liam failed to remain hidden until the right moment; he was caught immediately and the surprise was spoiled by the host's public announcement before he could see Mark.

transcript.content: said: "Hi—this is Eli, the host. I heard someone in the spare room; please come out and tell me your name and why you're here. If this was meant to be a surprise for a friend, I'm willing to listen, but I need to make sure my home and everyone here is safe, so please come out now."
